title: Dataset coverage
description: PROPOSED — NEEDS SIGN-OFF. The spec requires /data/coverage/<dataset-id>.json and a /coverage/ matrix route, but never defines what a dataset is or how claims belong to one. This schema proposes: a dataset is a named (publisher x doc_type x predicate-set) stream of records, and a claim belongs to it when its source publisher and doc_type match and its predicate is in the list. That makes membership derivable rather than hand-maintained, so a dataset's real year range can be computed from the data and checked against the declared one. Rule 8 — show the gaps — is the whole point: this file states what is NOT held, so an empty stretch on an entity page reads as 'no record' rather than 'nothing happened'.

$comment.description: Commentary on a fixture. Permitted in tests/fixtures only; validate.ts rejects this key anywhere under /data.

label.description: Rendered verbatim as the row heading in the /coverage/ matrix.

description.description: What this dataset is and where it comes from. Neutral, factual.

predicates.description: Predicate names this dataset supplies. Each must exist in predicates.json.

to.description: Omit if the dataset is current and still being added to.

reason.description: Why nothing is held. 'Not yet extracted' and 'does not exist' are different facts and must be worded differently.

breaks.description: Methodology discontinuities. A break is not a gap: data exists on both sides, but the two sides are not one series. Drawing a line straight across one is a false statement, so SPEC section 8 requires the line to stop and the break to be labelled. India's twenty-year window contains several — the 2015 GDP base-year revision, the 2017 replacement of the NSS employment rounds by PLFS, the 2011-12 reconstitution of the CPI.

at.description: The first date on the later side of the break.

description.description: What changed, in neutral terms, and what it means for comparison across the break.

comparable_across.description: True only where the publisher has issued a back-cast series on the new basis. Defaults to false, because the safe assumption is that two sides of a break cannot be compared.

note.description: Plain-language statement of what is and is not covered. Rendered on /coverage/ and on every entity page drawing on this dataset.
